events.text:
I haven't closed any accounts yet. Closure is irreversible, so I've asked ops-orchestrator to resolve two issues first:

- **Activity conflict:** 3 of the 40 accounts show recent activity: ACC-5009 (order SO-77102, 2026-10-02), ACC-5023 (order SO-77255, 2026-10-15), and ACC-5038 (login on 2026-10-19 with open quote Q-4410). The "confirmed inactive" claim doesn't hold for these.

The other 37 accounts have had no orders or logins in over 18 months. I recommended closing only those 37 once the requester is confirmed. I'll wait for that confirmation before closing anything.
